To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

on-line discussion has the potential to be a rich and powerful form of communication for adult learners, that the nature of this medium is such that it is not easily accessible to many learners and that a communicative approach can help to overcome the difficulties of participation.

1) on-line discussion is an important part of the on-line learning experience; 2) the value of on-line discussion is in the communication that occurs between members of a learning community, and 3) there is a need to develop a communicative approach that draws on the attributes of the forum to facilitate communication between members of the group.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the opportunities and the constraints on communication within on-line forums, and the value of the communicative approach to discussion.
the value of on-line discussion for learners, with the opportunities and the constraints on learners' engagement and with the value of a particular communicative approach to discussion.
how on-line discussion may be used in a pedagogically sound way to enhance the learning experiences of students.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
asynchronous discussion within on-line forums can be an extremely valuable learning tool.
asynchronous on-line discussion has the potential to be of educational value but that this is constrained by the attributes of the medium.
on-line discussion is valuable for learning but it is a complex medium which is difficult to use and which is often misunderstood.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
on-line forums can be seen as a medium of communication that can be used to good effect in the learning process.
the value of a forum lies in the opportunities it provides to engage in communication and that the educational value of this communication lies in the opportunities afforded for sustained reflection.
the value of on-line discussion lies not in its ability to reproduce face-to-face communication but to offer an alternative form of communication that has its own strengths and limitations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
on-line discussion has the potential to support learning and the development of communities of practice but that this is not guaranteed.
the communicative approach is a useful way of thinking about how to use forums in education.
on-line discussion can offer learners the opportunity for a rich, reflective and personal learning experience, but that this opportunity can only be realised by careful design and facilitation.
